name: Highland red noodles
summary: A red noodle bowl with field crab, cake balls, and boiled quail eggs, eaten with rau cần đước, bean sprouts, and scallion oil. One recipe builds a sour, sweet-nutty broth from tomato and cashew; another tops the bowl with crispy pork fat.
origin: A highland noodle bowl listed among Kon Tum’s dishes, eaten on a cool afternoon.
taste: Where the broth is tomato and cashew, it is red, sour, and sweet-nutty.
howToEat: Add the herbs, rau cần đước, bean sprouts, and scallion oil or scallion fat, and eat it hot. Some bowls carry fish-cake balls and cashew; others carry crispy pork fat.
where: Kon Tum city. It suits a cool highland afternoon.
seoTitle: Bun do in Kon Tum — red highland noodles
seoDescription: Field crab, cake balls, and quail eggs in a red highland noodle bowl, with rau cần đước and scallion oil.
